titulo: Unreal Past, Modal Perfect and Third Conditional
descripcion: At C2 the regret cluster extends to mixed conditionals, where a past condition produces a present result: if we had invested then, we'd be in a very different position now. This mixing is the natural, sophisticated form of regret about a past decision with ongoing consequences — not an error, as it's sometimes mistaught.

cuadroReferencia.notaPie: The choice of mixed pattern depends entirely on where the condition sits in time versus where the result sits — not on a fixed rule to memorise.

ejemplos.texto: If we had invested then, we'd be in a very different position now.
If she weren't so cautious, she would have taken the offer.
If I hadn't studied medicine, I probably wouldn't be so calm in a crisis.

notas: A mixed conditional is not a mistake — it's the correct form whenever the time of the condition and the time of the result genuinely differ.
The most common mixed pattern is past condition, present result; the reverse is rarer but equally valid.
Distinguishing this from a simple error requires checking whether the writer actually means two different time frames, or just confused the tenses.

contraste.es: El español logra la misma mezcla temporal con relativa naturalidad (si hubiéramos invertido entonces, ahora estaríamos en otra posición), así que el concepto no es nuevo — lo que falta es la confianza para usarlo activamente en inglés en vez de forzarlo a un patrón puro de tercer condicional.

errores: Forcing a mixed situation into a pure third conditional, losing the present-tense result.
Building a mixed conditional where the time frames don't actually differ, which is then a genuine error, not a valid mix.
Using would have in the if-clause of any variant.

autochequeo: Do the time frames of the condition and the result genuinely differ, justifying a mixed form?
Is the if-clause free of would/would have where a pure past perfect or past simple is needed?

Have I distinguished a genuine mix from an accidental one?
Would a native speaker read this as sophisticated, not confused?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on mixed conditionals. Check whether the time frames genuinely differ and whether each half of the sentence is internally correct. Do not rewrite the text.
